problem: P3: x a x^2 = c in S_N, (pq)(j)=p(q(j)); exhaustive over all x in S_N for every cycle-type representative a
conventions: cnt[c] = #Sol(a,c); blocks indexed by (ctype a, ctype c)

phaseA_first_moment.statement: sum_{c in gamma} #Sol(a,c) = #{x : ctype(a x^3)=gamma} = sum_nu rho_3(nu) * #{(z,w) in gamma x nu : z w = a}

phaseB_second_moment.statement: M2(alpha,gamma)=sum_{c in gamma}#Sol^2 = #{(x,y): x a x^2 = y a y^2, ctype(a x^3)=gamma}; Poisson prediction M1+M1^2/|gamma|

phaseC_word_invariants.invariant: J_L = multiset of orbit sizes of <a,c> + ctype(w(a,c)) for all cyclically reduced words w of length <= L (one per rotation/inversion class, no proper powers)

phaseD_per_lambda.statement: P3^lambda(a,c): exists x of cycle type lambda with x a x^2 = c; first_len_decided = smallest L such that P3^lambda is a function of J_L over all c (None = not decided by words <= maxlen)
